facts.business: Elin Electronics Limited is an Indian electronics manufacturing services company that produces fractional horsepower motors, lighting, fans, and small appliances such as chimneys, air coolers, OTGs, and OFR heaters, with integrated in-house capabilities across tooling, moulding, die casting, sheet metal, electronics, and motor fabrication.

segments.name: Small Appliances (Chimneys, Air Coolers, OTGs, OFR Heaters)

capacity_or_capex.item: Bhiwadi plant for assembly of chimneys, coolers, OFR, ceiling fans, OTGs and air fryers
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Commissioning moved from March to July-August 2026
